title: Pan-Seared Pork Belly with Tunisian Flair
description: A hearty, crispy-skinned pork belly dish infused with the bold flavors of Tunisia, served with a side of caramelized onions.
instructions: Pat the pork belly dry with paper towels.
Season the pork belly with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and harissa.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork belly for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork belly reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
While the pork belly is cooking, caramelize the onions by cooking them in a separate skillet over low heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the pork belly is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thick medallions.
Serve the pork belly with caramelized onions, fresh parsley, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with additional parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
